problemSignature.symptom: Generated holes and edge connectors were too close to odd outline notches.

rootCause: The odd-shape fixture generator placed mounting holes and side connectors from rectangular-board assumptions without checking distance to concave Edge.Cuts segments.
fixSummary: Move mounting holes and side connectors inward from concave outline features and validate the generated PCB with real KiCad DRC before promoting it to routing.

testsAdded: fixture runner creates odd-shape preroute KiCad artifacts without fake manufacturing

recipe: Place mechanical holes and edge connectors using outline-aware clearances, not rectangular offsets.
Run KiCad DRC immediately after fixture generation.
Reject or repair any copper_edge_clearance error before DSN export or FreeRouting.
safetyRules: Do not change protected ESC/FC projects.
Do not route a generated fixture with pre-route Edge.Cuts clearance errors.
Do not manufacture-export until DRC/ERC evidence is clean.
